name: hud_ui_text_input_move_cursor_right
description: HudUiTextInput::MoveCursorRight increments the cursor only while it is before the current text length.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiTextInput class/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b4570 validates inline strlen via repne scasb, comparing self->cursor against text length, and incrementing/storing cursor only when cursor < strlen(buffer).
Native smoke zhud_text_input_constructor_and_alloc_smoke verifies repeated MoveCursorRight calls advance the cursor to the end of 'abd' and stop at cursor 3.
